image_query: Modhera Sun Temple Gujarat Surya Kund
tweets: The Sun Temple of Modhera, Gujarat — raised in 1026–27 CE by the Solanki king Bhīma I for Sūrya. Its garbhagṛha is aligned so the equinox dawn sends sunlight straight into the sanctum, no lamp needed.

Before it, a stepped tank, Sūrya Kund, lined with 108 miniature shrines for ritual bathing — a design later echoed at Konark's Sun Temple, built two centuries after Modhera. Follow @yddoseOfHistory for your daily dose of history
